objective: Count how many of the specified products have at least 2 items available in the central Innsbruck PowerTool shop today.

params.store_identifier: lookup from stores WHERE city='Innsbruck' AND store_name LIKE '%PowerTool%'
params.product_descriptions: extract from instruction: list of 6 product descriptions, each to be resolved to SKU via product_variants, product_families, product_variant_properties using brand, series, model, and property filters
